primaryTextChecks.text: I will draw to you, to the river Kishon, Sisera, the captain of Jabin’s army, with his chariots and his multitude; and I will deliver him into your hand.’”

context.text: She sent and called Barak the son of Abinoam out of Kedesh Naphtali, and said to him, “Hasn’t the LORD, the God of Israel, commanded, ‘Go and lead the way to Mount Tabor, and take with you ten thousand men of the children of Naphtali and of the children of Zebulun?
Barak said to her, “If you will go with me, then I will go; but if you will not go with me, I will not go.”

primaryTextChecks.text: Sisera gathered together all his chariots, even nine hundred chariots of iron, and all the people who were with him, from Harosheth of the Gentiles, to the river Kishon.

context.text: They told Sisera that Barak the son of Abinoam had gone up to Mount Tabor.

Deborah said to Barak, “Go; for this is the day in which the LORD has delivered Sisera into your hand. Hasn’t the LORD gone out before you?” So Barak went down from Mount Tabor, and ten thousand men after him.

primaryTextChecks.text: The river Kishon swept them away, that ancient river, the river Kishon. My soul, march on with strength.

context.text: From the sky the stars fought. From their courses, they fought against Sisera.
Then the horse hoofs stamped because of the prancing, the prancing of their strong ones.
